decisions.reason: A reference-class electrometer is a core dosimetry instrument close to the firm's established offer, was just launched and featured on the home page, and fits its calibration and measurement strengths, so it will likely stay on the market for many years.

The oncology risk management software builds on the firm's QA platform, supports its strategy of integration, automation and prediction, and has its own page, so a recent launch like this is unlikely to be withdrawn within a year despite some uncertainty about adoption.
